name: Gatekeeper
motion: Armored breathing, key/hand movement and a braced stance; heavy armored steps wherever accepted movement exists
action: Key/fist wind-up and broad strike; guarded recoil; armor folds into a grounded collapse. Empowered presentation adds stronger stance/ember accents to the same resolved timeline
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PIXEL ART sixteen-pose animation sheet for GATEKEEPER. Use ONLY row THREE column ONE in supplied4x3 monster atlas for exact identity: massive armored dark-grey horned guardian, brown curved horns, closed angular visor with amber eyes, restrained orange V-shaped trim/ember cracks, burgundy cloth skirt, heavy boots/gauntlets, holding ONE distinct GOLD KEY with ROUND BOW and short toothed stem in its image-RIGHT hand. No crown, staff, sword or axe.
Exactly SIXTEEN full-body poses in a FOUR-COLUMN FOUR-ROW equal square grid. Same RIGHT-facing slight top-down three-quarter camera, palette, head/body scale and pixel size in all cells. Genuine coarse 16-bit RPG PIXEL ART: author at native48x48 logical pixels per cell and enlarge NEAREST NEIGHBOR. Hard chunky square clusters, dark stepped outlines and a small flat-color palette. No smooth digital painting, tiny brush texture, gradients, antialiasing, blur, bloom or subpixel shading.
Every entire horn, wing, tail, tongue, staff, axe and claw must fit wholly inside its ORIGINAL equal cell, with at least 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on EVERY edge. Common lowest foot/body ground baseline at 85% cell height. Airborne offsets are game-rendered: keep lowest body edge at that baseline even for tucked flight poses. Consistent body scale across sixteen poses; the final collapsed creature stays recognizable and substantial, not tiny particles.
Every row must contain at least THREE unmistakably different silhouettes at native48. True transparent alpha. No checkerboard, opaque background, labels, words, numbers, guides, borders, shadows, ground lines, detached particles/flame specks/electrical dots, speed streaks or extra monsters. All fire/electric accents must be small flat pixel clusters attached to the body. Return the complete transparent 4x4 pixel sheet.
Row ONE four distinct IDLE poses, ALL with BOTH boots DOWN FLAT on common ground baseline: C1 neutral armored breathing with key upright; C2 tiny eye blink and shoulders settle; C3 a distinctly BROADER BRACED stance with knees slightly bent and elbows away from body, key held firm; C4 key/hand grip shifts a little and helmet tilts. No foot lift/raised sole or walking in row ONE. Keep visor and key silhouette readable.
Row TWO four weighted armored WALK poses. IMPORTANT alternating walking feet: Row TWO column ONE raises the foot on the IMAGE-RIGHT side, bent knee and visible dark sole, with IMAGE-LEFT foot down flat. Column TWO plants IMAGE-RIGHT foot while LEFT heel lifts. Column THREE must raise the OPPOSITE IMAGE-LEFT foot BEHIND the body, knee bent backwards, dark underside visible with a transparent gap beneath it, while IMAGE-RIGHT foot stays DOWN FLAT as support. Column FOUR plants LEFT foot while RIGHT heel lifts. C1 and C3 must raise OPPOSITE feet. Do not repeat the front/right raised leg in both C1 and C3. Counter-swing arms and shift hips/hem with each leg. If robed, lift LEFT hem in C3 to reveal the raised left boot. Key stays fully visible and lags gently with the arm; skirt lifts on the corresponding boot.
Row THREE: C1 heavy fist winds back while key arm braces; C2 compact forward fist/key strike with the entire fist and gold key INSIDE the original cell's central70%; C3 returns to strong braced recovery; C4 guarded backward recoil, key protected against torso. No long reach into neighboring cells.
Row FOUR: shoulders sag and knees bend; guardian kneels with key lowering; armor folds into a lower grounded slump; complete substantial armored heap with helmet/horns and gold key resting attached to hand inside cell. All horns/key/boots remain whole. No debris, ground, shadow, detached ember spray or aura. Return full4x4 true-alpha sheet.
